hooks.command: sh -c 'd="${WORKSPACE:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}}"; [ -f "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] || d="$d/.."; [ -f "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] || exit 0; exec node "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" pre-bash'

sh -c 'd="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}}}"; [ -f "$d/bin/where-to-fix-hook.mjs" ] || d="${WORKSPACE:-$d}"; [ -f "$d/bin/where-to-fix-hook.mjs" ] || d="$(cd "$d/.." && pwd)"; node "$d/bin/where-to-fix-hook.mjs" || true'
sh -c 'd="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-${WORKSPACE:-$PWD}}"; [ -x "$d/bin/gh-frontaliere" ] || d="$WORKSPACE/bin/gh-frontaliere"; [ -x "$d" ] || exit 0; node "$d" ping >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'

sh -c 'w="${WORKSPACE:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || w="$w/.."; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || exit 0; d="$w/frontaliere-si-o-no"; [ -d "$d" ] || exit 0; c="$w/frontaliere-articles"; ( { cd "$d" && { sh "$w/bin/site-hook" scripts/prune-merged-worktrees.mjs --apply; node scripts/sync-main-checkout.mjs; }; [ -d "$c/.git" ] && cd "$c" && sh "$w/bin/site-hook" scripts/prune-merged-worktrees.mjs --apply; } & ) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'

sh -c 'w="${WORKSPACE:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || w="$w/.."; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || exit 0; ( cd "$w/frontaliere-si-o-no" && sh "$w/bin/site-hook" scripts/prune-merged-worktrees.mjs --apply --orphans-only ) 2>/dev/null; c="$w/frontaliere-articles"; [ -d "$c/.git" ] && cd "$c" && sh "$w/bin/site-hook" scripts/prune-merged-worktrees.mjs --apply --orphans-only 2>/dev/null || true'

sh -c 'd="${WORKSPACE:-${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}}"; [ -f "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] || d="$d/.."; [ -f "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" ] || exit 0; exec node "$d/bin/hook-dispatch.mjs" post-bash'
sh -c 'w="${WORKSPACE:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || w="$w/.."; [ -f "$w/bin/site-hook" ] || exit 0; exec sh "$w/bin/site-hook" scripts/ci/pr-watch-gate.mjs'
